paper.title: Algorithm 748: Enclosing Zeros of Continuous Functions

field: numerics (bracketing root finding and interval enclosure)

claim.text: ROOT printed by the authors' driver.f for NPROB=1, N=1 (first line of testdata), against the shipped testout value 1.8954942670340

attempt: The authors' driver.f and enclofx.f compile with conda-forge gfortran 16.2.0 (sandbox fetch step) and run on testdata with no source change, -O2 and -O0. Problem 1 root 1.8954942670339809 agrees with the shipped 1.8954942670340 to 2e-14, within tol_abs 1e-8. All 154 roots of the shipped testout agree within 1e-8 (max abs diff 4e-13) in both passes. exdrive.f is a separate standalone program with its own MAIN, not part of this driver, and is not linked. A first attempt linked it by mistake and failed at link time; that log is kept as evidence/original-attempt-mistaken-with-exdrive.log and is not the G1 attempt.

original_attempt.reason: Authors' driver.f and enclofx.f compiled and ran as documented with no source change (evidence/original-attempt.log).
